description: This file defines a Java interface 'ImagePut' with method signatures for adding images associated with a merchant store, indicating functionalities for image upload operations within the CMS module.

classes.name: ImagePut
classes.description: Interface for image upload operations in the CMS module, providing methods to add single or multiple images.

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Adds a single image for a specified merchant store; may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: addImages
methods.description: Adds multiple images for a specified merchant store; may throw ServiceException.
